A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PriorGuide and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–F. Corresponding content can be matched reliably despite additions, relocation, and renumbering.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original simulation experiments, posterior and predictive inference results, baseline comparisons, ablations, and computational-cost analyses.

after.justification: Retains the original empirical results and adds sequential Two Moons inference results and quantitative prior-ratio fitting diagnostics in Appendices D.2 and D.6.

M1.justification: The guidance equations, Gaussian reverse-kernel approximation, GMM ratio fitting, Langevin refinement, and Algorithms 1–2 remain unchanged. The sequential experiment applies the existing method to a posterior-derived prior without introducing a new algorithmic component.

E1.justification: Appendix D.2 adds a sequential Bayesian updating scenario on Two Moons: the posterior from one observation becomes the prior for another. This extends task coverage to complex, data-derived priors while retaining the original six simulator settings.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in existing experiments is unchanged: Simformer, ACE, rejection sampling, sampling-importance-resampling, and NLE with MCMC are retained. The new sequential experiment reuses Simformer and ACE.

E3.justification: The new sequential experiment uses ten parameter/observation pairs and a 1000 × 1000 reference-posterior grid. Appendix D.6 introduces a fitting evaluation across 100 mixture priors, estimating weighted log-space L2 error using 10,000 samples per fit. Existing experimental settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Adds direct assessment of GMM ratio-fitting accuracy and robustness in 10D, including conditional-slice visualizations, and a sequential-update case study using complex priors. Existing prior-shift, component-count, and compute-budget analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix D.6 newly reports fitting-error variability through the median and 2.5th, 25th, 75th, and 97.5th percentiles across 100 priors. The existing five-training-run mean/standard-deviation and Wilcoxon reporting practices remain unchanged and are reused in Table A2.

E6.justification: Existing numerical and graphical results are unchanged. New Table A2 reports sequential-inference C2ST of 0.60 ± 0.07 for PriorGuide, versus 0.89 ± 0.02 for Simformer and 0.94 ± 0.03 for ACE; all three RMSE means are 0.63. Appendix D.6 adds median fitting error 0.023.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 locally corrects the uniform-prior simplification from saying the ratio reduces to q to stating r is proportional to q, explaining cancellation of the constant in the logarithmic gradient. The propositions, formal assumptions, and Appendix B derivations and proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same central claims: flexible test-time prior adaptation without retraining, analytical GMM guidance, posterior and predictive inference, and a compute–accuracy tradeoff. The additional experiments support these existing claims.

C2.justification: Section 5 adds practical applicability recommendations and changes the scalability caveat from dimensions much greater than 10 to much greater than 20. New discussion addresses ACE's sequential-inference failure, RMSE's limitations for multimodal posteriors, and suboptimal GMM fits requiring multiple initializations.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement changes from promising a future code release to stating that code is available. New experiments document reference-grid construction, sampling counts, and fitting-error calculation. Existing implementation hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and resource estimates are retained.

R1.justification: Adds Bayesian Workflow and covariance/denoising references by Boys et al., Manor and Michaeli, and Rozet et al., and expands discussion of Geffner et al. The meta-prior comparison largely relocates from Appendix A.1 to Section 2.3, preserving the existing novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Adds Section 2.3 through relocation and adaptation of related-work material, expands explanations of priors and guidance, and adds two experimental subsections and an ethics statement. Affiliations and conference headers are updated; the overall narrative structure remains stable.

P2.justification: Adds Table A2 and Figures A2 and A4 for the new studies. Existing tables and figures are retained with renumbering and page reflow, including separation of the two algorithm displays across pages. There is no broad visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The sequential-update experiment and quantitative fitting diagnostics strengthen support for complex-prior adaptation and ratio-approximation reliability beyond v1's existing benchmarks and component-count ablation. Clearer applicability and metric discussion also improves interpretation. These are targeted gains; the core method, theoretical results, and main benchmark evidence remain substantially unchanged.
